method.unit: exchange (one real prompt + everything until the next)
method.interval: small-sample t interval (shown as "range", never "99%", D31) on log(recent/baseline), session-day cluster bootstrap, variance inflated K/(K-1)
method.mde: exp((t_0.995 + t_0.80) * SE) — 'changes smaller than this would not show'
method.gates: per metric per window: >=10 events, >=10 session-days, >=5 sessions, largest session <50% of denominator
method.verdictRule: >=2 material metrics from >=2 families, same direction, none opposite; material = CI excludes 1x AND >=25% relative AND >=1 point absolute

insufficient._why: Most common real outcome for a single user (spike: only tool errors had power; interrupts never). This is the PRIMARY hero state.
insufficient.headline: wasitme can already rule out changes bigger than about ×2.5 in tool errors.
insufficient.because: Too early to tell. Only tool errors have enough data so far; a change smaller than about ×2.5 in tool errors wouldn't show.
insufficient.detail: Interruptions are too rare to compare (2 in the last 14 days; 10 needed on each side).
insufficient.label: Too early to tell

unclear._why: Your effort change (Sep 21) and Claude Code serving a different model (Sep 23) land in the same week: decision table row 6 (METHOD.md §11), unclear (both_sides). (Two changes on your own side alone would be `you`, row 7.)
unclear.headline: Your numbers moved, but changes on both sides landed the same week.
unclear.because: Your numbers moved, but your effort change (Sep 21) and Claude Code's model switch (Sep 23) happened the same week.
unclear.tryThis: Undo your effort change to separate them; at your pace that takes about 5 weeks.
unclear.label: Can't tell which

you._why: Isolated user change (effort high→medium on Sep 21), no other event within ±7 days except routine version bumps that don't localize the shift.
you.headline: Your numbers moved around the time of your effort change (Sep 21).
you.because: Your numbers moved around the time of your effort change from high to medium (Sep 21): tool errors ×2.7, blind edits ×1.8. The Claude Code updates around it are routine and aren't evidence alone.

none.headline: No detectable change: changes bigger than about ×1.9 would have shown.

stale._why: Display state computed by every surface: now − generatedAt > staleAfterSec (default 2 h), a generatedAt more than 5 min in the future, or none. Shows the last known state dimmed beside the stale mark.

dailyToolErrors._note: Integer events per day (k errors / n tool calls). No per-day rate bands — days are too small. Window-level ratio + range are the only uncertainty shown.

coverageNote: Only sessions on this Mac are visible. Config tracking started Sep 5; earlier edits are invisible except what your logs recorded.

layouts._why: D28: the glance carries lead = timeline | verdict. Timeline-led (the day-1 hero for most single users, who mostly see "Too early to tell") opens on the change timeline with the verdict chip beside it; verdict-led opens on the verdict. Render both for every case.
layouts.timeline: Change timeline first (both sides, newest first), verdict chip + headline second.
layouts.verdict: Verdict label + headline first, metrics and timeline below.
